title: exam_item
description: One JLPT-style practice question, drawn from the corpus so every item is also findable in a lesson. The id prefix names the section, and each section has its own required shape.

x-yomineko.vocabulary_policy: Types, nesting and `required` are measured from the data. Value sets are not: every `enum` here is either declared in a design document, parsed from the code that produces the value, or curated in build_schemas.py with its source named in x-vocabulary. See contracts/README.md.

audio.description: The audio asset, or the literal `pending` while the TTS pipeline (design/listening.md) has not produced it yet. The first real filename must not fail the build.

speaker.description: Locale-neutral speaker slot the TTS pipeline maps to a voice. Vocabulary owner: design — design/listening.md (speaker registry — dialogue voices plus narrator). Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

x-vocabulary.source: design/listening.md (speaker registry — dialogue voices plus narrator)

allOf.title: known section
allOf.description: Every item's id names one of the declared exam sections. A typo'd prefix would otherwise match no branch and be validated by the envelope alone.

allOf.title: word-level multiple choice
allOf.description: kanji_reading / orthography: a word in isolation, four options. Applies to ids prefixed kr, or (2400 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: multiple choice inside a sentence
allOf.description: context_fill / grammar_form: the gap sits in a real corpus sentence. Applies to ids prefixed cf, gf (1720 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: ordering
allOf.description: sentence_order: the learner rebuilds the sentence from shuffled pieces. Applies to ids prefixed so (873 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: passage multiple choice
allOf.description: text_grammar / reading_comp: the item hangs off a reading passage, and the prompt is carried by `stem` or by `question` depending on the section. Applies to ids prefixed tg, rc (475 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: paraphrase
allOf.description: paraphrase: pick the sentence that means the same thing. Applies to ids prefixed pp (183 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: usage
allOf.description: usage: pick the sentence that uses the target word correctly. Applies to ids prefixed us (183 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.

allOf.title: listening
allOf.description: the five listening sections: a spoken script, its audio, and options. Applies to ids prefixed lt, lp, ls, lr, lg (239 items). `required` is measured at 100% presence per prefix; the branch itself is declared in build_schemas.py.
